revised_prompts: Photorealistic fixed safety-inspection camera still, 1920x1080 landscape. Camera mounted about 1.5 meters above floor, observing a utility-room passage with cabinets, exposed conduits, inspection access panels, large neutral floor tiles, and partial shadow from nearby structure. Rear-oblique medium-wide framing with natural perspective and realistic scale, enough surrounding context to judge body support. Visible subject: a middle-aged adult with medium build wearing a tan utility jacket and dark jeans, light neutral clothing, kneeling stably facing slightly away from the camera. The subject is clearly visible and supported on the knees in a normal upright kneel, with neither chest nor pelvis spread horizontally on the floor. Include a doorway and structural lines creating depth without blocking the subject. Plausible unedited inspection-camera capture, ordinary photographic detail, restrained contrast, not cinematic, not advertising. No text, no watermark, no logo, no annotation.
